en: Vintage black‑and‑white divided postcard with two photographic views. The upper image shows a large two‑storey masonry school building with a gabled roof, several chimneys, and tall windows, partly hidden behind a stone wall and trees. The captions in red Gothic‑style script read "Priestewitz." at the top left and "Schule." at the top right. The lower image shows a railway station area with multiple tracks, platforms, telegraph poles, a small trackside shack and a station building bordered by trees; this scene is captioned "Bahnhof." in red.
